defs.def: the dried leaves (called tea leaves ) of the tea bush 茶叶

ex.s: They teased the dog by fixing the treat to the screen.
A four-year tea promotion —Tea Road Cooperative Plan—was also issued in accordance with the initiative.
ex.t: 一项为期四年的茶叶推广活动——茶路合作计划——也根据该倡议发布。

ex.s: With pleasant flavours and scents, and coming in a variety of colours, fruit and herbal teas make a nice change to traditional teas.
ex.t: 水果茶和草药茶具有令人愉悦的味道和香味，并有多种颜色可供选择，与传统茶叶有很大的不同。

defs.def: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water onto tea leaves. It may be drunk with milk or lemon and/or sugar added. （沏好的）茶

ex.s: Fruit teas now include mango, strawberry, apple and pear.
ex.t: 水果茶现在包括芒果、草莓、苹果和梨。

ex.s: Herbal teas include blackberry leaf and dandelion.
ex.t: 花草茶包括黑莓叶和蒲公英。

defs.def: a cup of tea 一杯茶

ex.s: The invitation is clear: Weiner wants you to pick up a coffee or tea and sit down with this book.
ex.t: 邀请函很明确： Weiner希望您拿起一杯咖啡或茶，坐下来阅读这本书。

defs.def: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water onto the leaves of other plants （用其他植物的叶子沏的）热饮料

ex.s: Many people grow their very own tea gardens, in which they plant easy-to-grow herbs such as mint and lemongrass.
ex.t: 许多人自己种植茶园，在里面种植容易生长的草本植物，比如薄荷和柠檬草。

defs.def: 晚点，便餐（英国人傍晚时吃）
a light meal eaten in the afternoon or early evening, usually with sandwiches and/or biscuits and cakes and with tea to drink 茶点（在下午或傍晚，通常喝茶时还有三明治、饼干和蛋糕）

ex.s: There was a silence as Dad continued to drink his tea, and I held my breath.
ex.t: 当爸爸继续喝他的茶时，一阵沉默，我屏住了呼吸。

chunks.cn: 自己的茶叶 / 饮料茶叶 / 水果茶叶 / 传统的茶叶
